results.title: Forever
results.overview: A girl recounts a fleeting summer love in a poetic memory.

results.title: He Killed My Sister
results.overview: Malorie's sister Monica vanishes suddenly. Determined to learn the truth, Malorie investigates with her friend using clues Monica left behind. She becomes convinced Monica's husband, a presidential candidate, caused her sister's demise.

results.title: Cherry B
results.overview: It’s 1969, a housewives soiree, drinking cocktails whilst summoning up an old dead friend. When a spiritual message prompts adolescent Lilith to respond, it alerts us to the demon that lies within.

results.title: Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
results.original_title: Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
results.overview: A dark, camp-infused comedy about Mel, a non-binary person coming to terms with their identity. Much to their dismay, Evy ropes them into a Samhain retreat with their friends Remy, Tyler, and Sage. All Hades breaks loose when a demon from Mel's past returns to haunt them all after a seance goes awry. Mel is confronted by the demon they accidentally summoned in childhood - a manifestation of fear, shame, and unresolved identity. While their friends navigate their own Queer expressions through drag makeup, chaotic flirtations, and substance-fueled denial, Mel’s journey unfolds more subtly.

results.title: Plump Blossom
results.overview: In a fictitious dynasty inspired by ancient China, Princess Ruo Hua longs for a life beyond the rigid expectations of royalty. A passionate gourmand with a curious spirit, she secretly slips into the imperial kitchens at night to learn the art of cooking from the palace chef. Her quiet adventures take an unexpected turn when a wounded general is brought into hiding within the palace after a brutal conflict. Despite the danger, the compassionate princess chooses to help and protect him, revealing a quiet courage and selflessness beneath her gentle nature. Through shared meals, late-night conversations, and small acts of kindness, an unlikely bond begins to blossom between them. As their worlds slowly intertwine, the princess discovers that love, destiny, and true strength can emerge from the most unexpected places.

results.title: The Royal Christmas Mix-Up
results.overview: Lilah, a Manhattan-based professional gift concierge, travels upstate to rectify a gifting snafu when her client’s gift – a rare, antique nutcracker intended for the Queen of Monteblanca – accidentally ends up there. Upon her arrival, Lilah learns that the nutcracker has been accidentally designated as the grand prize for the local Christmavaganza Festival, and the only way to retrieve it is to compete in the Yuletide Games… together with her disgruntled client.

results.title: The Truth Rejects You, Cornelius
results.overview: A mixed-technique animated short film about a downtrodden dog attempting to explain his toxic relationship with Avalutsa the frog to his psychologist, a talking lobster.

results.title: Anya
results.overview: A young pregnant woman enters the freezing Danube with the intention of preventing her child from being born. The attempt fails, and Hajni is born; we follow six different moments from her life.

results.title: Tina and the Fly
results.overview: After a terrible breakup, a woman develops a toxic codependent relationship with a house fly.

results.title: A City in the Forest
results.overview: When a private police foundation in Atlanta tries to raze an urban forest to build the country’s largest police training facility, a diverse, decentralized, and intersectional movement defends the forest from what they call “Cop City.” A City in the Forest paints a collective portrait of the country’s most urgent social justice story, where a web of activists fight back against environmental racism, political corruption, police violence, and the criminalization of dissent.

results.title: Moving On
results.overview: In a dreamlike, suspended setting, a melancholy-looking boy finds himself alone on a vast green plain along with a single wooden chair. There she is visited by an ethereal and aloof woman who embodies her memories and past. With the help of a recited poem, the woman attracts the protagonist’s “inner child,” a symbol of her childhood and her fragility. Despite the boy’s bitterness, the woman and the child take hands and choose to continue together into the unknown, leaving the protagonist alone to deal with his own emptiness and the need to vanish in order to finally move on.

results.title: Imagine Festigal
results.overview: Campus Imagine is a secret, invite-only school for young innovators with unique skills. In their yearly challenge, the students are required to create an invention that will make the world a better place. Two teams compete against each other, both deciding on building an AI android assistant. While the Orange team builds Eliana, a sophisticated AI companion, the Pink team builds Libi, a silly automatic friend who specializes in compassion. As both robots learn about human emotions and mutual love, the school's manager schemes to harness Libi's heart to infuse his own big robot with hatred.

results.title: The Sorrow of Tomorrow
results.overview: In a quiet, old apartment just days before Christmas, Borghild, suffering from dementia, confuses night for day. She embarks on a journey of confusion and terror, re-living memories she wished remained forgotten.

results.title: Country Queer
results.overview: Benoît built his paradise hidden from view, emancipated in his own way, resolved to face the constraints of a space which, in imaginations, conflicts with his identity. The countryside. One day, he and other queers from the area decide to organize the first Pride of the Périgord vert, because it is time to come out, to take up space to celebrate, heal, and finally open a path.

results.title: Butterflies
results.overview: When a college student sets out to find a girlfriend, his relentless overthinking threatens to sabotage his chances.

results.title: We Are Not Dreaming
results.overview: Ciro, an overworked medical student and pole dance instructor, loses stability as Brazil’s university system collapses. Forced out of his home, he finds refuge with Antônio, a reclusive DJ, a meeting that reshapes both their survival and intimacy.

results.title: Headscarf
results.overview: Chemotherapy leaves Candela feeling undesirable and unseen. To brave love again, she must confront her shame and reclaim her femininity.

results.title: Distort 2: The Dead Among the Trees
results.original_title: Distort 2: The Dead Among the Trees
results.overview: Distort 2: The Dead Among the Trees follows a documentary crew investigating the disturbing tapes and local legends surrounding a woman who vanished deep within an Irish forest. As they retrace the events captured in the original recordings, the team begins experiencing the same strange and terrifying phenomena, suggesting the darkness in the woods was never truly gone.

results.title: Niñxs
results.overview: At the foot of Tepozteco, a sacred hill that governs the winds and fertility, lies the small town of Tepoztlán. Against this backdrop, fifteen-year-old Karla's body and mind are undergoing a revolution.
